about.title: A reliable engineer you can hand your business system to
about.bio: I'm Mahmoud, a full-stack developer from Egypt. By day I build ERP, POS and learning platforms in .NET; on the side I help businesses replace spreadsheets and paperwork with simple, fast web apps. I care about clean code, quick pages, and interfaces that work as well in Arabic as in English.
